reports.headline: Moviegoer's Family Will Not Leave Their House
reports.body: The family of the resident lost at the theater have not been seen outside their cottage {dir} of the village {dist} for days. {name} knocked and the door swung open. {they} saw the family sitting in a row, watching a blank wall, and something standing among them that was shaped like a person and was not one.

reports.headline: Neighbours Fear for the Family at the Cottage
reports.body: Since the theater took one of their own, the family at the cottage {dir} of here {dist} sit up every night facing the wall. {name} says one of them turned to look at {them} with a face that was folding in on itself.
